title: VA Multi-Store Task & Inventory Tracking Sheet System
summary: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) dashboard and multi-client virtual assistant daily task logger with automated time utilization formulas.
problem: Freelance virtual assistants balancing multiple administrative workflows require structured logging to prevent missed client milestones and ensure accurate task reporting.
whatIDid: Drafted structured SOP templates covering supplier communications, daily listing checks, and customer inquiry response protocols.
Engineered an automated time-utilization tracking sheet with timestamp formatting and category aggregation (Admin, Listing, Customer Support).
Configured automated status highlights for overdue or pending items.
Prepared clean PDF and Google Docs deliverable templates formatted for executive handover.
result: Created a complete operational template toolkit ready for deployment across e-commerce and administrative VA assignments [PORTFOLIO WORK SAMPLE].

media.alt: VA Task Tracking and SOP Documentation Sheet
media.caption: Executive summary view detailing task categories, completion timestamps, and operational checklists.
